_meta.hard_rule_3: Unreported fields are the literal string "not_reported". No estimation, no inference, no carry-over from model knowledge of the trial.

field_conventions.grade3plus_any_pct: ANY-CAUSE grade >=3 rate. Where a source reports only TREATMENT-RELATED grade >=3, the any-cause field is "not_reported" and the TRAE figure is carried in treatment_related_grade3plus_pct instead. Where a source reports grade 3 and grade 4 separately and never sums them, the field is "not_reported" and the split is given in notes - per hard rule 3 the grades were NOT added together.
field_conventions.dose_reduction_pct: A true dose-reduction rate. Sources reporting only 'dose modification' or 'interruption and/or reduction' are "not_reported", with the modification figure in notes, because modification is a wider category than reduction.

qualified_not_reported.explanation: Four fields carry a value PLUS a 'not_reported as...' caveat (the source reports a related but non-identical quantity). They are counted as reported-with-caveat, not in the 85.

genuinely_empty_rows: EORTC 55971 + CHORUS pooled (Vergote 2018) - survival-only re-analysis, no new safety data
TRUST / ENGOT-ov33 (Reuss 2019) - design paper, no results yet
counts.note: Counts computed programmatically over the parsed JSON, not hand-tallied.
